- Shortened names and strings throughout (projects Harbor Alpha/Beta/Gamma, doc "Harbor checklist", shorter contents, request sets description to 'Done after sign-off.').

Design is otherwise unchanged: target is the at-risk project with Maya Chen's "Harbor checklist" document mentioning dry-run results; reference query roots at `projects` with the `e_doc` binding edge and `e_creator` edge; F1 uses SUB `creatorId`→`updatedById`, F5 uses SPLIT groups `[["f_title","f_content"],["e_creator"]]`; write is `projectUpdate` description.
